description: This file implements a thread-safe pseudorandom bit generator pool (RandenPool) using internal classes and functions, including thread-local and platform-specific thread ID management, seed initialization, and random number generation methods.

classes.name: RandenPoolEntry
classes.description: A thread-safe pseudorandom bit generator class implementing a single generator within a RandenPool, managing internal state, refill logic, and byte filling.

methods.name: RandenPoolEntry::Init
methods.description: Initializes the generator state with provided seed data.

methods.name: RandenPoolEntry::Fill
methods.description: Fills a buffer with random bytes generated from the internal state.

methods.name: RandenPool::Generate
methods.description: Generates a random value of specified type using thread-local pool.

methods.name: RandenPool::Fill
methods.description: Fills a span with random data using thread-local pool.
